layout.text: Project BIM installation layouts onto real surfaces.

BIM-driven laser spatial augmented reality for in-situ layout and
            assembly
Overview

We developed a workflow that converts BIM geometry into laser
            projection paths, together
Why measure and mark what BIM already defines?

A BIM model can specify the dimensions and intended locations of
        windows, HVAC components, a

Displaying the design on a screen does not eliminate this manual
        layout process.

Laser projection displays the installation layout directly on the
